sloka: एवम् उक्त्वा तु दिव्येन विमानेन वपुष्मता ।आरुरोह दिवम् क्षिप्रम् मुनि पुत्रः जित इन्द्रियः ॥२-६४-५१॥
transliteration: evam uktvā tu divyena vimānena vapuṣmatā ।āruroha divam kṣipram muni putraḥ jita indriyaḥ ॥2-64-51॥

translations.english: The sage's son with his senses under control said this while ascending heaven on a beautiful, celestial, aerial chariot.
